doc.text:
Tools to work with sorted arrays, in a more efficient way.

DISCLAIMER: All types of utils only usable in a sorted array.

fields.name: binarySearch

doc.text: Gets the index of a possible new element of an Array of T using an efficient algorithm.

params.array: Array of T to check in
params.getVal: Function that returns the position value of T

fields.name: addSorted

doc.text: Adds to a sorted array, using binary search.

params.getVal: Function that returns the value that needs to be sorted

fields.name: removeSorted

doc.text: Removes from a sorted array, using binary search.

params.getVal: Function that returns the value that needs to be sorted
